summary: Read and reply to letters from Hermes.
page_description: Read and reply to letters from your own Hermes Agent. The inbox and your drafts stay readable offline, and replies are sent when the gateway is back.
release_notes: Setup shows the login command set apart and complete, with no reader address to look up.

steps.text: Deploy a compatible Hermes gateway behind HTTPS and note its address.
Once per reader: with it plugged in over USB, run kobo setup --enable-ssh. Then save it so the commands below find it on Wi-Fi without an address.
Sign Post in. The token is checked against the gateway before it is installed.
